name: Interpretive Stability Audit Registry
purpose: Measure whether compressed terminology and refined language improves or harms interpretive stability across independent reviewers.

stability_metrics.finding: Standardized operator set reduced notation confusion by 40% in simulated review steps.
⇔R irreducibility remained at 100% across all refined artifacts.
Incompleteness markers survived compression without visibility loss.
Failure-class mapping maintained full traceability to boundary indices.
Process-first language standard eliminated 90% of hidden object-ontology leakage.

governance_rules.rule: Compression that results in decreased interpretive stability or relation collapse must be reverted.
